**Task, fixed inputs, and acceptance criteria**

**Baseline and alternative**
Include model, effort, tier, Codex version, tools, context, and run order.

**Results**
Sample size, acceptance rate, total time, human rework, failed attempts, and
observed usage. Count owner, children, review, and retries. Keep unavailable
values unknown. See docs/MEASURING.md; token counts are not quota percentages.

**Reproduction and limitations**
Share synthetic/public inputs only, and describe confounding factors.
